findings.text: LocalFlags no longer adds global flag.CommandLine flags for root commands. The old code had explicit handling when !c.HasParent() to copy global flags, but this was removed. A root command calling LocalFlags will miss all global flags.

The addToLocal closure excludes flags found in parentsPflags, but parentsPflags contains persistent flags from ALL parents. If a parent's persistent flag has the same name as a local flag, the local flag won't be included in LocalFlags output.

updateParentsPersistentFlags initializes c.parentsPflags with c.Name() as the FlagSet name, but this set aggregates flags from all parent commands. Using the child command's name for a parent-aggregated flag set is semantically incorrect and could cause confusion in error messages or debugging.

0.reason: The reference bug is about child flags shadowing parent persistent flags being excluded from local flags, not about global flag.CommandLine flags for root commands; the removal of global flag copying is a separate change and the finding does not match the reference mechanism.

2.reason: Using c.Name() as the FlagSet name for parentsPflags is only a naming choice for error messages/debugging and does not affect functionality or the reference bug's mechanism.
